key.name: font
key.description: A Pango font description such as “Monospace 11”; empty for the desktop's monospace font.

key.name: cursor-shape
key.description: The shape of the cursor until a program asks for another.

key.name: scrollback-lines
key.description: How many lines that scrolled off the top are kept to scroll back to.

key.name: custom-command
key.description: A command line that tabs run instead of the shell, split into words the way the shell does; empty for the shell.

key.name: scroll-on-output
key.description: Whether output brings a view scrolled back into the history to the bottom.

key.name: scroll-on-keystroke
key.description: Whether typing or pasting brings a view scrolled back into the history to the bottom.

key.name: audible-bell
key.description: Whether the bell a program rings makes a sound. A tab in the background is marked either way.

key.name: title-bar
key.description: Whether windows show the title bar. Without it, the context menu has its commands.

key.name: window-size
key.description: The size of new windows; 0 fits 80 columns by 24 lines of the font.
